items.name: sand3d
items.description: 3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs.
items.readme:
sand3d

**3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs.** sand3d is a Python library for writing 3D objects as short programs: profiles, solids, edits, frames, joints and assemblies, over Blender's `bpy`. A program says *how* a shape is made, part by part and in its own words, so a model writes it in a few hundred tokens and a person can read it.

 Website ·  Docs ·  Datasets ·  Explorer

## Why sand3d


How it is measured, part by part

- **Short.** A part takes 2 to 6× fewer tokens than the same part in Blender Python, CadQuery or FeatureScript ([details](https://sand3d.sandflow.ai/tokens.html)). - **The whole API fits in a prompt**, about 3,600 tokens ([the API](https://sand3d.sandflow.ai/api.html)). - **Named, not computed.** Parts, edges and faces are reached by name, never by hand-computed coordinates. - **Deterministic.** The same program builds the same mesh, bit for bit. ## A whole object, part by part

A front-loading washing machine in 38 lines of code ([play it and read it](https://sand3d.sandflow.ai/gallery.html)): the cabinet, the drum, the door with its glass and handle, the detergent drawer and the dial, each a named part, and four joints that say how they move. ```python door = s3d.group("door", ring, glass, handle) # the handle and the glass move with it s3d.joint("door_hinge", door, hinge, axis="-Z", range=(0, 143)) s3d.joint("drum_spin", drum, front.move(0, 400), kind="continuous") s3d.joint("drawer_slide", drawer, top_band.move(150), kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 200)) s3d.joint("dial_turn", dial, top_band.move(-150), kind="continuous") return s3d.assembly("washing_machine", cab, drum, door, drawer, dial, front=front) ``` ## Export: GLB, URDF, USD, OBJ, STL One call; the file's extension names the format; lengths in metres. ```python s3d.export(machine, "washer.glb") # or .urdf, .usda, .obj, .stl ``` | format | what it carries | for | |---|---|---| | **GLB** | meshes, materials, the joints in each node's extras, at the current pose | the web, viewers, game engines | | **URDF** | a link per moving part, its joints and their limits, at rest; OBJ meshes beside it | ROS, PyBullet, MuJoCo, Isaac | | **USDA** | the same tree in OpenUSD (UsdGeom, UsdPhysics), with the materials | Omniverse, Isaac Sim, USD pipelines | | **OBJ**, **STL** | the meshes alone, at the current pose: OBJ Y up, binary STL Z up | any 3D tool, slicers | `.usd`, `.usdc` and `.usdz` come from the `.usda` through USD's own tools (`usdcat`, `usdzip`). The scene is also an ordinary Blender scene, for anything else Blender writes. ## Install Python 3.13 (recommended) or 3.11. Blender comes with it, as the `bpy` module: 5.2 LTS on Python 3.13, 4.5 LTS on Python 3.11; CI runs bpy 5.2. ```bash pip install sand3d # or, in a uv project: uv add sand3d ``` `bpy` has no wheel for Python 3.12, nor for Intel Macs from 5.2 on: there, use Python 3.11. ## A first program ```python import sand3d as s3d def bracket(w=80, d=40, t=6, hole_d=6.6, pitch=50): plate = s3d.extrude("plate", s3d.rect(w, d, r=4), t) s3d.hole(plate, hole_d, on=s3d.grid(2, 1, pitch, 0)) s3d.fillet(plate, 1, edges="top") return plate s3d.export(bracket(), "bracket.glb") ``` Millimetres by default. Every verb with code that runs and its render: [the quickstart](https://sand3d.sandflow.ai/quickstart.html); objects to play joint by joint: [the gallery](https://sand3d.sandflow.ai/gallery.html); every signature: [the API](https://sand3d.sandflow.ai/api.html). The programs themselves: [docs/examples/](https://github.com/Sandflow-ai/sand3d/tree/main/docs/examples/) and [programs/](https://github.com/Sandflow-ai/sand3d/tree/main/programs/). ## Give it to your LLM Put [docs/api.md](https://github.com/Sandflow-ai/sand3d/blob/main/docs/api.md) in the system prompt: the rules of the vocabulary, every signature, and worked examples, in about 3 600 tokens; [llms.txt](https://github.com/Sandflow-ai/sand3d/blob/main/llms.txt) points a model at it. For objects of several parts, [the guidelines](https://sand3d.sandflow.ai/guidelines.html) give the eight rules of an assembly program: the plan first, then the details, then the parts. ## What is in it Everything on one flat `s3d.` surface: | family | verbs | |---|---| | profiles | `rect` `circle` `slot` `polygon` `poly` `arc` `spline` `superellipse` `text` `offset` `stroke` … (16) | | solids and paths | `extrude` `revolve` `sweep` `loft` `wire` `helix` `box` `cylinder` `tube` `sphere` `torus` `dome` … (15) | | edits | `cut` `join` `intersect` `split` `hole` `pocket` `fillet` `chamfer` `shell` `dent` … (15) | | frames and placement | `Frame` `face` `edge` `bbox` `local` `at` `transform` `grid` `ring` `along` `snap` | | articulation | `joint` `pose` `seat` | | assembly | `group` `assembly` `attach` `export` `units` `fingerprint` … (8) | | parts and materials | `gear` `knurl` `thread` `material` | No category verbs (`chair()`, `table()`): a category is a program written *in* sand3d. ## Datasets sand3d programs for five sources of 3D objects, on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0.

sand3d-objaverse · Objaverse
Everyday objects from Objaverse, each rebuilt as a program.
sand3d-cad · CAD
Mechanical parts from public CAD models.
sand3d-articraft · Articraft
Articulated objects from Articraft, their joints declared.

sand3d-simready · SimReady
Simulation-ready assets from NVIDIA SimReady.
sand3d-automate · AutoMate
Mechanical assemblies from AutoMate, each part a function of its program.
Browse them in [the explorer](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Sandflow/sand3d-explorer), or all five in [the collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/Sandflow/sand3d-6aec268fbdcd3bc174236168). ## Citation If you use sand3d in your work, please cite it. `CITATION.cff` holds the same, and GitHub shows it as "Cite this repository". ```bibtex @misc{sand3d2026, author = {Neveu, Thibault and Loy, Andr{\'e}a}, title = {sand3d}, year = {2026}, note = {Version 1.6.3}, url = {https://github.com/Sandflow-ai/sand3d} } ``` ## Contributing and license How the library is built, tested and versioned: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Sandflow-ai/sand3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Apache License 2.0: see [LICENSE](https://github.com/Sandflow-ai/sand3d/blob/main/LICENSE).

items.description: A lightweight 2.5D character player for the web, with lip sync and webcam face tracking.
items.readme:
A lightweight 2.5D character player for the web, with lip sync and webcam face tracking. A few lines of code put a character in a page, a stream overlay or an app.
Comes with 21 featured characters in different styles, ready to use.

English · 中文 · 日本語 · Tiếng Việt

- WebGL2, no dependencies, about 30 KB gzipped for the core - Lip sync (microphone, audio, video) and webcam face tracking (MediaPipe), both in the browser, imported only when you need them - Plays LivLiv, VRM and PNGTuber characters through the same API - 21 featured characters in [`characters/`](characters/), ready to use ## Try it - **Online**: the examples run on [livliv-dev.github.io/player](https://livliv-dev.github.io/player/). - **Here**: `npm install && npm run build`, serve this folder with any static server and open `/example/demo.html` (expressions, actions, microphone, camera; `?model=../characters//` picks another character). `/example/png.html` and `/example/vrm.html` show a PNGTuber and a VRM. - **On livliv.ai**: each character's page there plays it with the same renderer. Start at [livliv.ai/discover](https://livliv.ai/discover). ## Use it in your page ```sh npm install @livliv-dev/player ``` ```js import { Player } from '@livliv-dev/player' const player = new Player(document.querySelector('canvas')) await player.load('characters/k01/') // a folder with model.json and textures/, or a .livliv file player.setExpression('smile') // ids are in player.expressions player.act('nod') player.params.mouthOpen = 0.6 // 0..1 ``` Lip sync and face tracking: ```js import { createSpeech } from '@livliv-dev/player/voice' import { startFaceTracking } from '@livliv-dev/player/tracking' // needs @mediapipe/tasks-vision const speech = createSpeech(player) button.onclick = () => { speech.unlock(); speech.say('/reply.mp3') } await startFaceTracking(player) ``` A VRM or a PNGTuber, on the same API: ```js import { BodyPlayer } from '@livliv-dev/player/body' import { VrmBody } from '@livliv-dev/player/vrm' // needs three and @pixiv/three-vrm import { PngBody } from '@livliv-dev/player/png' const vrm = new BodyPlayer(canvasA, new VrmBody()) await vrm.load('/avatars/me.vrm') const png = new BodyPlayer(canvasB, new PngBody()) await png.load({ closed: 'me-closed.png', open: 'me-open.png' }) ``` The whole API is in [API.md](API.md): options, params, expressions and actions, drivers, VRM and PNGTuber characters, the limits on untrusted files, the model package and the format version. The LivLiv package format (`.livliv`, `model.json` v4) is in [FORMAT.md](FORMAT.md), with a JSON Schema in [`schema/`](schema/); packages exported before v4 are described in [FORMAT-v3.md](FORMAT-v3.md) and still play. > The npm package is the player alone. The featured characters are in this repository's [`characters/`](characters/): copy > the ones you use next to your page, with their licence. ## Featured characters `characters/` holds 21 characters, ready to `load()`. They carry a small LivLiv mark in the bottom-right corner, which the player draws. They are **not** covered by the Apache License. Most were made by LivLiv: use those free for personal, non-commercial projects with credit ("Characters: LivLiv (livliv.ai)"); don't sell them, use them commercially or train AI models on them. Nana is LivLiv's mascot. The terms are in [characters/LICENSE.md](characters/LICENSE.md). Kujira, Kujira Q and Pen come from other people's work: that licence and that credit don't cover them. Their sources, credits and terms are in [characters/CREDITS.md](characters/CREDITS.md). Each also has a `cover.webp` (512 x 768, about 50 KB), its first frame without the mark. `player.load(source, { poster })` shows it on the canvas until the first frame. To have it before any script has run, put it under the canvas with `object-fit: contain` and fade the character in over it, as [example/loading.js](example/loading.js) does. | id | name | id | name | id | name | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | `k01` | Sena | `d01` | Yui | `v01` | Aster | | `k02` | Elio | `d02` | Leo | `v03` | Mira | | `char06` | Aoi | `d03` | Nana | `v04` | Kai | | `char07` | Sora | `d03ft` | Nana (refined) | `v05` | Lilith | | `s01` | Hana | `p01` | Kujira | `v06` | Usa | | `q02` | Mochi | `p02` | Kujira Q | `v07` | Stella | | `q03` | Kotaro | `p03` | Pen | `w01` | Max | ## Characters of your own You can bring in a PNGTuber's pictures, or a VRM (drawn with three.js); or make a character of your own from one picture on [livliv.ai](https://livliv.ai). - **A PNGTuber**: two pictures (mouth closed, mouth open), and two more with the eyes closed if you have them. - **A VRM**: from VRoid Studio or any tool that exports VRM 0.x or 1.0. - **A LivLiv model**: make one from a picture on [livliv.ai](https://livliv.ai), then download its model package from the character's page (**Model package**): a `.livliv` file. Pass it to `load()` as it is (a URL, or the `File` someone picked), or unzipped as a folder. Packages on the free plan carry the LivLiv mark, and the player draws it. ## About the player and the characters LivLiv Player and the `.livliv` format are LivLiv's own work. They use no Live2D software or Cubism SDK and do not read `.moc3` or `.cmo3` files. "Live2D" is a trademark of Live2D Inc.; LivLiv is not affiliated with it. Making a character on livliv.ai uses AI. The player itself only plays: it calls no AI service and reads only the files you point it at. Face tracking runs Google's MediaPipe in the browser, and camera images stay on the device; API.md has the networking details. The featured characters in this repository were made on LivLiv too, also with AI; Kujira, Kujira Q and Pen adapt other people's characters ([credits](characters/CREDITS.md)). Refined Nana (`d03ft`) also has swinging parts and head-turn keyforms added with LivLiv's own tools. A package's `meta.author` and `meta.license` record who made it and on what terms: keep them and follow them. When you show a character made with LivLiv in public, say that AI was used to make it, and don't present it as hand-drawn or hand-rigged. ## Embed without code ```html ``` The same `/live/` page has a transparent background and works as an OBS Browser Source. ## Develop ```sh git clone https://github.com/livliv-dev/player cd player npm install npm run check # types npm run build # dist/: index.js, tracking.js, voice.js, body.js, png.js, vrm.js (ES modules), chunks/ and types/ npm test # unit and fuzz tests (Node 22.18 or newer, no browser) npm run test:browser # every featured character drawn in headless Chromium; once: npx playwright-core install chromium-headless-shell npm run test:engines # a sample on Firefox and WebKit, where WebGL2 starts (a GPU or a software GL); once: npx playwright-core install firefox webkit ``` `src/runtime/` is the renderer and motion code livliv.ai runs; this repository is published from it. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Security reports: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## Browser support WebGL2 and ES2023: Chrome / Edge 97+, Firefox 104+, Safari 15.4+. Tested on current desktop browsers, not yet on phones. ## License The code is under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) (see also [NOTICE](NOTICE)). The featured characters have their own licence, [characters/LICENSE.md](characters/LICENSE.md). Neither licence covers the LivLiv name and logos. ## Thanks Thanks to 上善无形, ZipZipPipe and 贱兔死顺盖, whose characters Kujira, Kujira Q and Pen are based on: see [characters/CREDITS.md](characters/CREDITS.md).

更改play商店支付方式即可，和谷歌账号属地无关

**Google AI Pro (5 TB) 零成本两年 (US$0.00 -> 24个月) 全自动控制台**

> 以上述“零成本两年”为项目目标，不代表已验证的订阅结果。原说明中的“全程 0 扣费”不能作为保证，实际费用和权益以结账页面及上游结果为准。

### 一、运行环境要求
1. Windows 10 / 11 系统
2. 已安装 Google Chrome 浏览器（默认路径即可）
3. 已安装 Python 3.10 或更高版本（安装时勾选 Add Python to PATH）
4. 网络环境：本机开启美区（US）代理，或在控制台左侧填写代理模板

### 二、快速启动步骤
1. 首次使用请双击运行：【1_首次运行_安装依赖并启动.bat】
2. 之后日常使用直接双击：【2_启动控制台.bat】
3. 浏览器会自动打开控制台页面：http://127.0.0.1:8765

### 三、自定义填写支付卡 & 跑号说明
#### 1. 填写支付卡（必填）：
   - 在网页左侧【全局配置与内联免税绑卡】区域，填入你自己的 Visa 或 Mastercard 外币卡：
     * 卡号（16位数字）
     * 有效期（月 / 年，如 08 / 29）
     * 安全码（3位 CVC）
     * 持卡人英文姓名
     * 免税邮编默认已填好 97201（美国俄勒冈免税州），无需修改
   - 填写后点击【💾 保存配置】。
   - 注：脚本内置严格 0 元消费保护，仅在结账弹窗确认为 US$0.00 时才会点击订阅，全程 0 扣费。

#### 2. 批量导入 Google 账号：
   - 在网页右侧【批量放号导入区】粘贴账号（每行一个），支持以下任意格式：
     * 邮箱----密码----辅助邮箱
     * 邮箱----密码----辅助邮箱----2FA密钥
     * 邮箱----密码----2FA密钥
   - 点击【➕ 一键导入账号列表】。

#### 3. 开始全自动执行：
   - 点击单个账号右侧的【▶ 执行】或顶部的【▶ 批量全自动执行】。
   - 脚本会自动完成：
     - Step 1: 自动登录 Google 并通过辅助邮箱 / 2FA 验证
     - Step 2: 内联免税绑卡 + 首层 12 个月免费包 (US$0.00)
     - Step 3: 叠加二层 6 个月免费包 (US$0.00 -> 18个月)
     - Step 4: 叠加三层 6 个月免费包 (US$0.00 -> 24个月封顶)
     - Step 5: 自动前往 Google Play 取消自动续订，锁死 2 年到期权益并截图验真

### 四、隔离与敏感数据

- 浏览器扩展版位于 `extension/`，批量版位于 `batch/`，两者分目录存放。批量版原启动脚本使用当前 Python 环境安装依赖，未提供独立虚拟环境，不能宣称依赖完全隔离。
- 批量版按账号使用独立浏览器配置目录，但这不等于虚拟机或安全沙箱。
- 账号密码、2FA 密钥、支付卡信息和浏览器登录数据属于敏感信息；本地配置、浏览器配置目录、截图、日志及缓存不应提交到仓库。


## 使用入口

- **浏览器扩展版**：打开 Chrome 扩展管理页，开启开发者模式，选择“加载已解压的扩展程序”，加载 `extension` 目录。
- **批量版**：在 Windows 下进入 `batch` 目录，首次使用运行 `1_首次运行_安装依赖并启动.bat`，之后运行 `2_启动控制台.bat`。

两个版本独立使用。本次整理仅增加仓库分层和本页介绍，不修改项目源代码。

本地账号与支付配置（`config*.json`）、环境变量文件、缓存和运行数据不提交到仓库；批量版的配置请在本地填写。

# 搞机工具箱 Web - 网页版 Android 玩机工具 ##

使用教程  在线体验

《搞机工具箱》是一款ADB图形化工具。 本项目移植于个人开发的 [《搞机工具箱》PC版](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1QvHhzLELb) 。借助 [Tango](https://github.com/yume-chan/ya-webadb) 实现了 WebADB，并通过 [xterm.js](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) 打通 Android 原生 Shell 交互式终端，可运行在基于Chromium内核的浏览器中，实现免下载、免安装的跨平台使用体验。 [作者 @晨钟酱Official](https://space.bilibili.com/251013709) [官网: jamcz.com](https://jamcz.com) ## 功能 | 页面 | 主要功能 | | --- | --- | | 主页 | 设备与系统信息、CPU 频率、主板 ID 隐藏、重启、关机、重启至 Bootloader / Fastbootd / Recovery / EDL | | 软件管理 | 包名与前台活动读取、启用/禁用、运行、强行停止、卸载与保留数据卸载、清除数据、软件信息、恢复系统软件、卸载锁定、操作记录、Google 套件批量管理 | | 安装与文件传输 | APK 安装、拆分 APK 安装、推送文件、提取安装包 | | 显示控制 | 分辨率、显示密度（DPI / dp）、按键模拟、截图 | | 系统界面 | 状态栏图标隐藏、时钟与快捷设置、沉浸模式、Wi-Fi 网络检测相关设置 | | 电池管理 | 电池信息、电池参数模拟与恢复、定时统计、可选功率记录、CSV 导出 | | 无极调节 | 字体大小倍数、窗口/过渡/程序动画倍率、自动锁屏时间 | | 控机脚本 | 脚本编辑与导入导出、命令插入、文件关联、部分 BAT 语法解释执行 | | ADB 终端 | Android Shell 交互会话、ANSI 显示、命令历史、补全、复制、清屏与中断 | | 软件设置 | 默认启动页、主题配色、界面缩放、CPU 更新间隔、文件接收路径、安装与截图选项、设置导入导出 | 当前界面提供 **USB 有线连接**。功能是否生效取决于设备的 Android 版本、ROM 和 ADB Shell 权限。进入 Fastboot 的按钮仅发送重启命令，本工具暂不提供 Fastboot 刷机功能。 ## 快速开始 ### 使用条件 - 使用支持 WebUSB 的 Chrome 或 Edge 或 其他基于Chromium内核的浏览器（不分操作系统，手机安装Chrome也能用）。 - 手机开启开发者选项和 USB 调试，使用 USB 数据线连接电脑。 - 通过本机 `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` 或 HTTPS 网站访问页面。 - Windows 需要能够正常识别手机的 ADB USB 接口，且手机端同意授权请求。 ### 本地运行 仓库默认为 **HTML、CSS、JavaScript的前端分离版** ，同时提供AIO的 **单HTML整合版**。页面和第三方依赖均保存在本地，可直接本地部署或执行，无需构建或安装 npm 依赖。 #### 方法1: 整合版 下载项目docs中的index.html。已内嵌完整依赖，使用Chromium内核浏览器直接本地运行。 #### 方法2: 分离版 1. 下载并解压完整项目，保留目录结构。 2. 安装 [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/)，在包含 `server.cjs` 的目录打开终端。 3. 运行： ```powershell node server.cjs ``` 4. 使用 Chrome 或 Edge 打开 [http://127.0.0.1:8124](http://127.0.0.1:8124)。 5. 点击“连接设备”，在浏览器中选择手机；首次连接时，在手机上确认 USB 调试授权。 按 `Ctrl+C` 停止服务。服务只监听本机地址 `127.0.0.1`。 若默认端口被占用，可在 PowerShell 中更换端口： ```powershell $env:PORT = "8080" node server.cjs ``` 随后打开 [http://127.0.0.1:8080](http://127.0.0.1:8080)。也可以使用其他能够正确提供 ES 模块的静态网页服务器。 **请通过网页服务器打开分离版。** 直接双击 `index.html` 会使用 `file://` 地址，外部 ES 模块可能因浏览器的跨源限制而加载失败，导致连接按钮不可用。参见 [MDN：JavaScript 模块](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Modules)。 ## 部署到网站 将本目录中的完整文件上传到支持 HTTPS 的静态托管服务或 Web 服务器，以 `index.html` 为入口即可。第三方依赖已包含在 `js/vendor/` 中，运行时无需额外从 CDN 下载依赖，也不需要部署 ADB 后端。 - 保留 `index.html`、`css/`、`js/`、`assets/` 的相对路径。 - 对外提供服务时使用 HTTPS。本机回环地址属于浏览器认可的可信来源，因此本地开发可以使用 HTTP。参见 [MDN：安全上下文](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Security/Defenses/Secure_Contexts)。 - JavaScript 应返回有效的 JavaScript MIME 类型，例如 `text/javascript`；CSS 应返回 `text/css`。不要将它们统一返回为 `application/octet-stream`。 - 如果自行改为 CDN 引用，脚本、样式和模块依赖也应使用 HTTPS，避免被浏览器作为混合内容屏蔽。 - `server.cjs` 是可选的本地启动工具；部署到静态托管平台后，访问者无需安装 Node.js。 WebUSB 的授权和使用条件可参考 [Chrome WebUSB 文档](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/capabilities/usb)。 ## 目录结构 ```text . ├── index.html # 页面结构与模块入口 ├── README.md # 项目说明 ├── LICENSE # 项目 GPLv3 许可证全文 ├── server.cjs # 本地静态服务器（Node.js 标准库） ├── LICENSE-Tango.txt # Tango 相关组件许可 ├── LICENSE-xterm.txt # xterm.js 相关组件许可 ├── assets/ │ └── favicon.svg # 页面图标 ├── docs/ │ └── index.html # 完整本地运行文件 ├── css/ │ ├── styles.css # 工具箱样式 │ └── xterm.css # 终端样式 └── js/ ├── app.js # 页面初始化、交互、连接状态与设置 ├── core.js # 命令执行与各功能逻辑 ├── transport.js # Tango / WebUSB 连接与传输 ├── terminal.js # 交互式终端会话 ├── batch.js # BAT 语法子集解释器 └── vendor/ # 本地第三方依赖 ``` ## 终端与脚本 ### ADB 终端 终端连接的是手机上的 Android Shell，可直接输入 Shell 命令： ```sh getprop ro.product.model wm size settings get system font_scale ``` 同一连接中的终端会话保留当前目录和环境变量；切换页面不会重新创建会话。历史记录和补全由设备上的 Shell 提供，`Ctrl+C` 可中断正在运行的命令。断开设备或重新启动终端会结束当前会话。 ### BAT 脚本 控机脚本通过 JavaScript 解释部分 BAT 语法，将其中的 ADB 操作转换为浏览器端调用，**不会启动 Windows 的 `cmd.exe` 或执行电脑上的 EXE**。 例如，可以导入并执行以下脚本： ```bat @echo off echo 读取设备型号 adb shell getprop ro.product.model timeout /t 1 adb shell wm size ``` 支持的语法包括 `echo`、`rem`、`set`、`set /a`、`set /p`、变量替换、标签与 `goto`、部分 `if` 条件、`if errorlevel`、多行括号形式的 `for /l`、`timeout`、`choice /t`、`pause` 和 `exit /b`。具体支持范围以解释器实现为准。 涉及 `adb push`、`adb install` 等本地文件操作时，需要先在页面中关联对应文件。浏览器无法仅凭脚本中的 Windows 路径读取电脑文件。 这套解释器兼容的是 BAT 语法子集。依赖外部程序、PowerShell、`for /f` 或复杂 CMD 语法的脚本需要调整；遇到不支持的命令时会报告错误。 ## 数据保存与文件下载 - **设置、脚本文本、软件操作记录**：保存在当前网站的浏览器本地存储中。清理网站数据会删除这些内容；设置和脚本可通过页面提供的功能导出备份。 - **ADB 身份密钥**：由 Tango 保存在浏览器 IndexedDB 中。可在断开设备后，通过软件设置清除。 - **网站地址变更**：不同协议、域名或端口使用独立的网站存储，迁移部署地址后可能需要重新授权和导入设置。 - **截图与电池统计**：需要及时下载保存，当前页面内的临时数据不会跨刷新保留。 - **电池 CSV**：文件名使用连接设备读取到的机型名称和日期时间，例如 `一加 15T_2026-11-03_14-30-00.csv`；无法读取营销名称时回退到系统型号。 - **下载目录**：可在支持的浏览器中授权保存目录；未授权时使用普通浏览器下载。截图“下载后删除手机原图”仅在确认写入所选目录后执行，普通浏览器下载会保留手机原图。 设备命令通过浏览器与手机之间的 USB 连接执行，不经过本项目的远程 ADB 服务。文件与目录访问需要用户通过浏览器选择或授权。 ## 常见问题 | 问题 | 排查方法 | | --- | --- | | 连接按钮是灰色的 | 使用 Chrome / Edge，通过本地服务器或 HTTPS 打开完整目录；检查开发者工具中的模块加载错误、404 和 MIME 类型错误。 | | 提示当前 ADB 接口被占用 | 在任务管理器中结束占用接口的 `adb.exe`，关闭其他 ADB 工具及已连接设备的 WebADB 页面，再重新连接。 | | 浏览器找不到设备 | 检查 USB 调试、数据线与 USB 接口，以及 Windows 下的 ADB 驱动；确认数据线支持数据传输。 | | 手机没有授权弹框 | 解锁手机并检查 USB 调试；已有有效授权时可能不会再次弹框。仍无法连接时，可在手机开发者选项撤销 USB 调试授权后重试。 | | 资源被屏蔽为 `mixed-content` | HTTPS 页面引用了 HTTP 资源，需将相关资源及其依赖改为 HTTPS。 | | 提示 `application/octet-stream` 或 MIME 错误 | 检查静态资源服务器的响应头，按扩展名设置正确的 JavaScript / CSS 类型。 | | 命令返回权限不足、设置不生效 | Android 版本、厂商 ROM 和系统策略可能限制 ADB Shell 权限；部分设备还需开启厂商提供的 USB 调试安全选项。 | | CPU 频率、功率或主板 ID 无法读取 | 部分设备不开放对应系统节点。功率记录依赖设备提供的电流、电压等数据，不等同于外接充电功率计测量值。 | | 关闭或刷新页面后连接断开 | USB 会话依附于当前页面，需要重新连接；请提前下载需要保留的数据。 | ## 开发与反馈 本分离版直接使用原生 JavaScript ES 模块。修改后启动 `server.cjs` 并刷新页面即可查看效果，无需执行依赖安装或打包命令。 - 修改页面布局：`index.html`。 - 修改样式：`css/styles.css`。 - 修改页面交互与设置：`js/app.js`。 - 修改设备命令和功能逻辑：`js/core.js`。 - 修改 USB 连接、终端或脚本解释：分别查看 `js/transport.js`、`js/terminal.js`、`js/batch.js`。 - 更新第三方组件时，检查模块引用与接口兼容性，并保留相应的版权及许可证文件。 欢迎通过仓库的 Issues 反馈问题或提交 Pull Request。反馈时请提供工具版本、浏览器版本、电脑系统、设备型号、Android / ROM 版本、复现步骤和相关错误信息。提交截图或命令输出前，请隐藏设备序列号、主板 ID 等个人设备信息。 涉及设备行为的修改，请说明实际测试设备及结果；未经实机验证的行为请明确注明。 ## 第三方项目 感谢以下开源项目： | 项目 | 使用组件与版本 | 许可 | | --- | --- | --- | | [Tango / ya-webadb](https://github.com/yume-chan/ya-webadb) | `@yume-chan/adb` 2.6.4、`adb-daemon-webusb` 2.3.2、`adb-credential-web` 2.1.0、`stream-extra` 2.6.1、`struct` 2.3.2、`event` 2.0.0、`async` 4.1.3、`no-data-view` 2.0.0 | [MIT](LICENSE-Tango.txt) | | [xterm.js](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) | `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0、`@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0 | [MIT](LICENSE-xterm.txt) | ### 项目许可 本项目的原创代码采用 **GNU General Public License v3.0（GPL-3.0-only）**，许可证全文见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 Copyright (C) 2026 晨钟酱Official。 第三方组件保留各自的版权与 MIT 许可，详见 [LICENSE-Tango.txt](LICENSE-Tango.txt) 和 [LICENSE-xterm.txt](LICENSE-xterm.txt)。分发时请保留这些声明。 本软件按许可证所述提供，不附带任何担保。 ## 使用说明 本工具为全安卓通用软件。使用本工具则代表您有一定玩机知识储备。若盲目操作导致无法开机或丢失数据则后果自负，作者不承担任何责任。

items.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux
items.readme:
A tiny, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux.
Runs your Docker images and works with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx you already use.

Download · Features · Build from source · Releases

--- Kiri is a lightweight replacement for Docker Desktop and OrbStack, written in Rust. It runs containers in one small Linux VM (or straight on the kernel on Linux) and speaks the Docker Engine API, so your tools just work. The name comes from the Igbo word *ntakịrị*, "small". ## Why Kiri - **Fast**: a container starts and exits in about 2.5 ms through the Docker API. That's around 80 times faster than Docker Desktop. - **Light**: the VM sleeps after 60 s idle, the daemon stays at about 15 MB, and it wakes in about 0.15 s. - **Compatible**: `docker`, Compose, buildx, `docker login` and amd64 images through Rosetta. - **Local domains**: `http://.kiri.local`, with HTTPS from Kiri's own certificate authority. - **More than containers**: a one-command Kubernetes cluster and Linux machines. - **A native window** for containers, images, volumes and networks, plus a menu bar item. ## Install | Platform | Get it | |----------|--------| | macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel) | `.dmg` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Windows 10 and 11 (x86-64 or Arm, through WSL 2) | `.msi` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) | `.deb` or `.rpm` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | The first time you open Kiri, it sets up a `kiri` Docker context. Kiri updates itself, and checks each new release's signature first. ## Quick start ```sh docker --context kiri run --rm alpine echo hello docker --context kiri compose up -d kiri k8s start # single-node Kubernetes as the `kiri` kubectl context kiri machine create dev --distro ubuntu && kiri machine shell dev kiri import # bring images, volumes and containers over from OrbStack or Docker Desktop ``` Docker's commands also work as `kiri` commands (`kiri run`, `kiri ps`, `kiri compose up`, and so on), and always target Kiri. ## Numbers `alpine` running `true` and removed, median of 30 runs, same `docker` CLI for all three: | | Docker Engine API | `docker` CLI | |----------------|------------------:|-------------:| | **Kiri** | **2.55 ms** | **14.2 ms** | | Docker Desktop | 213 ms | 243 ms | | OrbStack | 380 ms | 442 ms | Method and every other figure are in [`bench/results.json`](bench/results.json). Rerun with `kiri bench`. ## How it works ``` docker CLI ─┐ compose ────┼─ Docker Engine API ─► kiri daemon ── vsock ──► guest agent (PID 1) buildx ─────┤ owns the VM clone3 → container kiri UI ────┘ ``` The VM uses a custom 10 MB kernel, and its PID 1 is a ~900 KB Rust agent. That agent starts containers with a single `clone3` into namespaces and a cgroup. There's no runc, no shim and no dockerd.
